- agent-shim.py:113,199; orch-bus-confirmation-poller.py:36-38,136;

DIVERGENCE: (1) auth — Bearer-preferred vs loopback-aware Basic vs Bearer-only
(telegram-bridge:157); (2) only canonical has retry+outbox+BusPermanentError+
junk-subject+priority-normalize; copies silently drop on outage; (3) telegram-bridge

others return {"msg_id": None}; (5) verifier bypasses HTTP.

gateway/bridge signatures as thin wrappers. Regression test: non-loopback→Basic,
